name: stock-market
description: A end-to-end machine learning pipeline that predicts 60-day directional price moves for TSLA using only technical indicators derived from OHLCV data.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "ML,API,UI" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow,magenta" "cd ml-service && source venv/bin/activate && python3 main.py" "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
